entries.title: vault.asset() == underlyingToken is never checked in either concrete constructor; story-050 adds a third and fourth call site inheriting the assumption
entries.evidence: grep -rn "asset()" src/ -> zero occurrences. Both constructors validate only non-zero-ness. convertToShares/convertToAssets are the sole decimal bridge between underlyingToken and vault shares. _exitFloor adds call sites at :128 and :132.
entries.reason: code-scan.md declined to file it on the grounds that it is an owner-deployment-time check with an obvious failure mode ('nothing works'), so it fails the Law-3 surprise test. Dedup DISAGREES with that premise: a vault whose asset() differs only in DECIMALS mis-scales every conversion SILENTLY rather than failing loudly, which would pass the surprise test and make it an in-scope footgun. Not confident enough to overrule the scanning agent's on-code judgement; too security-relevant to remove. Human adjudication requested.

entries.title: StableStakerV2.setYieldStrategy idle sweep has no require(credited > 0); at slippageToleranceBps == MAX_BPS it sweeps the entire shared underwater-withdrawal buffer in for zero booked principal
entries.evidence: stake (:333) and depositFor (:713) both carry require(credited > 0, "StableStaker: nothing credited"); the idle sweep does not. The empty-pool gate require(poolInfo[token].totalStaked == 0) at :258 means no staker is exposed at that instant, but the buffer is gone for everyone who stakes after.
entries.reason: Belongs to stable-staker, not to the reflax ledger; no run-17 reflax finding owns it, so without parking it would evaporate between ledgers. Route to the next stable-staker regression run.

entries.title: The dominance downgrade of DEDUP-17-01 and DEDUP-17-03 is contingent on two code invariants that no test currently pins
invariants: p <= D : totalDeposited[token] == sum(clientBalances[token][*]) (AYieldStrategy.sol:48) — verified mechanically this run, every write to either map is paired
a <= p : _withdrawInternal caps amount to clientBalances[balanceHolder] before calling _disposeShares (AYieldStrategy.sol:772-776)
entries.evidence: Negative controls T2 (drop p<=D) and T3 (drop a<=p) both produce counterexamples immediately (T2 witness a=2,p=2,D=1,B=1,Sv=1,Av=1; Halmos T3 witness a=2^63,p=1,D=1,B=2^62). The dominance is a property of THIS CODE, not of the integers.
entries.reason: A future unpaired write to clientBalances/totalDeposited (a client-balance transfer, a migration helper touching one map), or any future exit path reaching _disposeShares/_exitFloor without first capping to the caller's principal, silently destroys the dominance and RE-ARMS both findings at Medium WITH NO SCANNER SIGNAL. Not a finding today; a tripwire that must be visible in triage. workspace/reflax-yield-vault/test/symbolic/DominanceRun17Grounding.t.sol is a runnable regression test for exactly this and should be kept.

entries.title: The minter-cushion suppression on DEDUP-17-03 rests entirely on PhusdStableMinter having no strategy-exit path
entries.evidence: MigrateStableStakerMainnet.s.sol:496 (newYs.setClient(PHUSD_STABLE_MINTER, true)) and :595 (newYs.setClient(address(stableStaker), true)) wire BOTH as clients of the same newYsDola/newYsUsdc ERC4626YieldStrategy. The suppression holds only because the minter has no withdraw path and therefore cannot be the first mover in the race.
entries.reason: If a future story gives PhusdStableMinter any strategy-exit path, the premise dies and DEDUP-17-03's client-vs-client leg becomes a live Medium immediately. A suppression with an expiry condition must be visible, not buried in a scan report.
entries.reopenTrigger: any code granting PhusdStableMinter a strategy-withdraw / strategy-exit path
